scripts.generate-api: npm run clean-api && openapi-generator-cli generate -i openapi/openapi.yaml -g typescript-axios -o ./frontend/src/generated-api-types
scripts.dev-backend: if not defined DB_URL set "DB_URL=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/ai_workspace" && if not defined DB_USERNAME set "DB_USERNAME=postgres" && if not defined DB_PASSWORD set "DB_PASSWORD=postgres" && if not defined APP_JWT_ACCESS_SECRET set "APP_JWT_ACCESS_SECRET=dev-only-access-secret-change-me-at-least-32-bytes" && if not defined APP_JWT_ACCESS_TTL set "APP_JWT_ACCESS_TTL=PT15M" && if not defined APP_AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE set "APP_AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE=false" && backend\mvnw.cmd -f backend\pom.xml spring-boot:run
